guides.aFullScreenPageOn: A full-screen page on the workstation PC: big buttons to report production, request repair, do inspection rounds, request first article inspection, and clock in/out.
guides.aTemplateDefinesTheStandard: A template defines the standard tags, purpose mapping and default 3D model for a class of equipment. Equipment of the same model can apply it in bulk.
guides.adminsTurnOnTheAi: Admins turn on the AI master switch and individual AI features here, and choose the run mode (real LLM / demo / record). **Everything is off by default**.
guides.afterImportingTheWorkshopCad: After importing the workshop CAD floor plan (DXF), equipment is **auto-placed by the equipment code** in block attributes; drag any that don't match into position. If the delivery package has a GLB it's used; otherwise 3D is generated from the equipment template.
guides.agentTriageSuggestionsAndRecently: Agent triage suggestions and recently closed Andons are here. Full history is in "Andon Records".
guides.aiIsOffByDefault: AI is off by default. An admin turns on the master switch and the needed features in "System › AI Features"; with AI off, non-AI actions like trace, copy and open record still work.
guides.allMotionsSlowerThanStandard: All motions slower than standard, sorted by loss. "Affects Output" = in the bottleneck group, really losing pieces; "Potential" = not on the bottleneck, only wasting labor time for now.
guides.anyNumberTableRowOr: Any number, table row or equipment card can be handed to AI: hold `Ctrl` and click to add it to the context, or **right-click** for explain, trace, generate report and more.
guides.anythingAiDoesThatNeeds: Anything AI does that needs human confirmation goes to the "Approval Center" and only runs once confirmed.
guides.arAndApBalancesAnd: AR and AP balances and overdue amounts.
guides.arApAgingExpandTo: AR / AP aging (expand to see each invoice), receipt / payment recording, customer / supplier statements (generate → send → counterparty confirms).
guides.arApReceivablesPayablesAging: ar ap receivables payables aging statements
guides.arShippedReturnsReceiptsMatches: AR = shipped − returns − receipts (matches statements); **aging** by invoice due date, uninvoiced items by shipment date + payment terms. Receipts and payments are applied to invoices automatically when recorded.
guides.askDataAiWatchAutomations: Ask Data, AI Watch, Automations, Agents and the Approval Center all require an admin to enable the corresponding feature in "System › AI Features" first; when off, this page shows "Disabled".
guides.automaticallySlicesEveryCycleAnd: Automatically slices every cycle and every motion's time from equipment **motion signals** (solenoid valve → limit switch, cycle start/stop, program block number). Find the **bottleneck workstation** first, then the **bottleneck motion**, compare with standard time and baseline, and convert seconds lost per cycle into **pieces and money**.
guides.backOnTheDesktopOpen: Back on the desktop, open "Production Reports"; the newest is at the top: check the work order, operation, quantity, reporter and time. Hold `Ctrl` and click a row to have AI check it for anomalies.
guides.barsAreOeeTheThree: Bars are OEE; the three lines are availability, performance and quality: whichever line is low is where the loss is. Click a bar to see that machine.
guides.barsRunFromMostTo: Bars run from most to fewest defects; the line is the cumulative share: the top two or three categories usually make up most of it, so fix those first.
guides.belowTheWorkOrderDetails: Below the work order details is the operation list: click "**Dispatch**" to assign an operation to a person. It shows up right away on the Workstation Terminal and in "My Tasks" on mobile.
guides.bottleneckWorkstationTheOneWith: Bottleneck workstation = the one with the longest per-piece cycle time after accounting for parallel machines; bottleneck motion = its motion that's furthest over standard time. Losses are converted via daily cycle count to pcs/day and ¥/year (change the unit value in "Parameters").
guides.changeIntervalsAndContentIn: Change intervals and content in "Maintenance Plans", check history in "Execution Records". Follow up repair orders raised by abnormal results in "Repair Orders".
guides.changeParametersLineTimeRange: Change parameters (line, time range…) and click "Run". Results are the same charts and tables, with each step's query listed below.
guides.chaseOverdueDeliveriesFirstReceipts: Chase overdue deliveries first; receipts in incoming inspection are put away once QC decides.
guides.checkQuantitiesAndLaborHours: Check quantities and labor hours; click "Approve" if all is well, or "Return" with a reason if not.
guides.checkTagsOneByOne: Check tags one by one: in the tag list but **unreadable is red**, read but **not in the tag list is yellow**, values **out of the normal range are orange**, normal is green. Tags that pass and are confirmed count toward coverage.
guides.checksSerializedPartDataFor: Checks serialized part data for gaps: which parts are missing operation records, heat links or inspection results.
guides.chooseADataSourceEnter: Choose a data source, enter the minutes and start discovery. Sparkplug B birth certificates include metric types and units, which are shown too.
guides.chooseAPeriodGenerateOne: Choose a period → generate (one voucher per document; regenerating doesn't duplicate) → choose a format and export. Map GL accounts to those in the customer's accounting software in "Account Mapping".
guides.chooseAPermissionPresetAll: Choose a permission preset (all read-only / equipment & cycle time / quality / read-only + drafting), optionally restricting line scope and expiry. The plaintext key is shown only once.
guides.chooseAWarehouseEnterThe: Choose a warehouse, enter the counted quantity, and the system generates a stocktake adjustment.
guides.chooseBuiltInErpOr: Choose **built-in ERP** or **external ERP** (which system masters customers, materials, orders) and which transactions are written back; configure webhooks, staging database, Kingdee / Yonyou connectors; monitor the delivery queue, failures and retries.
guides.chooseFromTheLast2: Choose from the last 2 hours to 7 days. Use 8 hours for a shift, 24 hours or more for trends.
guides.chooseTheDefectCategoryAnd: Choose the defect category and time range.
guides.chooseTheInspectionCharacteristicE: Choose the inspection characteristic (e.g. bore diameter), equipment and sample size (how many recent parts).
guides.chooseThePlanningHorizonAnd: Choose the planning horizon and click "Run MRP". Each run marks unhandled suggestions from the previous run as ignored.
guides.chooseTheTypeAndEquipment: Choose the type and equipment, and describe the issue in one sentence. Once raised, the relevant team leaders and maintenance are notified.
guides.clickAHeaderToSort: Click a header to sort, click a row to open details (related records below, e.g. operations under a work order). Hold `Ctrl` and click a row to hand it to AI; right-click for more actions.
guides.clickAMetricToOpen: Click a metric to open its analysis page; hold `Ctrl` and click to have AI explain it.
guides.clickARowToOpen: Click a row to open traceability: which castings this heat poured and what happened to each one.
guides.clickARowToOpen2: Click a row to open it; "Dispatch", "Start", "Complete" and "Verify" buttons appear by status. On completion, record the failure cause and fix; it becomes searchable in the Knowledge Base later.
guides.clickARowToOpen3: Click a row to open it; "Enter Values" judges automatically against the template's limits.
guides.clickARowToOpen4: Click a row to open and edit it; with AI on, AI can draft D2–D5 while it's a draft.
guides.clickARowToOpen5: Click a row to open the document: drafts are editable; confirmed sales orders go through "Change Order" (tracked, version + 1).
guides.clickARowToOpen6: Click a row to open the purchase order.
guides.clickARowToSee: Click a row to see details, its inspection plans and repair records; the details have an "OEE" button that jumps straight to the analysis page.
guides.clickARowToSee2: Click a row to see its tag list; when connected to the virtual factory, the tag list can be imported in one click.
guides.clickARowToSee3: Click a row to see the variance breakdown and calculation details. Rates are maintained in "Cost Rates"; after changing them click "Recalculate WO Costs" (closed periods aren't recalculated).
guides.clickAVoucherToSee: Click a voucher to see its entries and auxiliary accounting (customer, supplier, material).
guides.clickEquipmentToSeeIts: Click equipment to see its tags, latest values and confirmation status.
guides.clickIntoAPartWith: Click into a part with gaps to see which step is missing; back-fill it or check equipment data collection for the cause.
guides.clickNewChooseTheProduct: Click "New": choose the product and enter quantity, due date and priority. A new work order is a **draft** and isn't scheduled yet.
guides.clickPendingNcrsToDisposition: Click "Pending NCRs" to disposition them; click Cpk to open SPC analysis and view control charts.
guides.cmmAndFirstArticleMeasurement: CMM and first-article measurement data can be imported as CSV and judged automatically against inspection item limits.
guides.compareCostAndSavingsPer: Compare cost and savings per ton against the usual mix. Once confirmed, "Save as Current Mix"; each heat then backflushes charge stock according to it.
guides.configureDataCollectionMqttUnified: Configure data collection: MQTT (Unified Namespace), OPC UA, Modbus TCP, plus which equipment each tag belongs to and its display name.
guides.confirmAllGreenTagsAt: Confirm all green tags at once. For red / orange tags, have the integrator check the address or range first, then confirm once fixed.
guides.copyTheConfigForYour: Copy the config for your tool. Remote: HTTP URL + X-API-Key header; local can also use stdio: `python -m honeymom mcp`.
guides.countsOfWarningsAndTools: Counts of warnings and tools due for change. Tools due for change should be replaced at the next changeover.
guides.coverageConfirmedTagsAllTags: **Coverage = confirmed tags / all tags**. Acceptance requires 100%: every tag has been checked (readable, sensible values). Addresses received that aren't in the tag list show up under "To Confirm".
guides.cpk133IsCapable: Cpk ≥ 1.33 is capable, 1.0–1.33 acceptable, < 1.0 insufficient and needs improvement. More than 0 out-of-control points means the process has special causes.
guides.createWorkOrderScheduleDispatch: Create work order → schedule → dispatch to workstations
guides.ctrlClickAnyNumberTo: `Ctrl`+click any number to hand it to AI and ask why.
guides.cycleTimeAnalysisTaktMotion: cycle time analysis takt motion cylinder bottleneck
guides.dataSourcesTagListCollection: data sources tag list collection connectivity
guides.defectsThatOnlyShowUp: Defects that only show up after machining and inspection are traced back by part code to heat, ladle, pouring temperature, residual magnesium and molding sand, to find the **factors that differ the most**.
guides.demoModeReplaysRecordedAnswers: Demo mode replays recorded answers and uses no tokens; record mode calls the real LLM and records the answers.
guides.draftsForTagsAwaitingConfirmation: Drafts for tags awaiting confirmation, one draft per machine, with confidence and rationale.
guides.eachCardEquipmentStatusPower: Each card: equipment, status, power, OEE and a few key tags (by display name). Click to see all tags and action buttons; right-click to request repair, view OEE or have AI troubleshoot.
guides.eachChartShowsTheDefect: Each chart shows the defect rate grouped by one factor; the red bar is the worst group. Those marked "Significant" are worth checking first.
guides.eachHeatSChemistryPower: Each heat's chemistry, power consumption and tapping temperature, plus **how many castings poured from it were later scrapped**. Use it to find the relationship between melting parameters and scrap.
guides.eachMachineSCurrentStatus: Each machine's current status (running, idle, changeover, down, offline), power, 8-hour OEE and key tags, **refreshed every 3 seconds**. Check here first when something goes wrong on the shop floor.
guides.eachPersonSDailyProduction: Each person's daily production reports, labor hours and review. Team leaders check and submit them here.
guides.eachRowShowsTheLast: Each row shows the last value, receive count and value quality issues (never changes, out of range, uncorrelated with running status). If all looks good, click "Confirm".
guides.eachSuggestionExplainsWhichWork: Each suggestion explains which work orders change and the impact on due dates; accepting updates the schedule automatically.
guides.electricityMeterReadingsAggregatedHo: Electricity meter readings aggregated hourly: total consumption, furnace energy per ton, energy per piece, and consumption split across **peak and off-peak periods**.
guides.enterAPartCodeOr: Enter a part code or heat number to see the part's **complete history** from melting and pouring to machining, inspection and shipping.
guides.enterTheChargeWeightAnd: Enter the charge weight and the upper/lower limits for each element, then click "Solve". (An admin must enable "Charge Optimization" in "System › AI Features" for this page)
guides.equipmentMasterDataCodeType: Equipment master data: code, type, line, model, collection tags. Monitoring, OEE, repair and inspection rounds all link to equipment defined here.
guides.everyConnectionAndCallIs: Every connection and call is in the audit log: who, when, what was called, how many milliseconds, and whether it succeeded.
guides.everyPageTitleHasA: Every page title has a "?": it explains what the page does, when to use it and what to do next. There are also three **task walkthroughs**: production report, quality inspection, scheduling.
guides.everyProductionReportMobileWorkstati: Every production report (mobile, Workstation Terminal, automatic from equipment) is here: who, which operation, how many good, how many defective. **Correct wrong quantities here**.
guides.expandNodesToSeeAttributes: Expand nodes to see attributes, tick variables, choose the equipment and add them to the tag list (to confirm).
guides.filterByDataSourceEquipment: Filter by data source, equipment or color. On the left is each machine's check progress bar (green / orange / red).
guides.filterByStatusClickA: Filter by status; click a row to open details: operations, production reports and parts are all below.
guides.filterByStatusRequestedDispatched: Filter by status: Requested → Dispatched → In Repair → Completed → Verified.
guides.filterByTypeOperationOr: Filter by type, operation or keyword; click one to preview it on the right (PDFs, images and DXF drawings all view online). Causes and fixes recorded when repair orders are completed also accumulate here.
guides.firstArticleLotHoldRework: first article lot hold rework quality gate
guides.firstArticlePatrolAndFinal: First article, patrol and final inspections are all opened in "Inspection Records": click "New" and choose the inspection type, part or work order, and **inspection template** (which defines the items and limits).
guides.forMachinesWithALot: For machines with a lot of downtime, go to "OEE Analysis" to see where the losses are; for repairs, click "Request Repair" in the details to create a repair order.
guides.forMachinesWithHighScrap: For machines with high scrap rates, check tool life and program version first.
guides.forMachinesWithMotionSignals: For machines with motion signals but no model yet, click "Auto-Detect Motions": AI proposes a motion list and standard times from recent signal sequences, **effective only after an engineer confirms**.
guides.fromSalesOrderDeliverySchedules: From sales order delivery schedules, forecasts and safety stock, multi-level BOM explosion produces **planned production** and **planned purchases**, each pegged to the order that needs it; late open orders are flagged to **expedite**.
guides.fullScreenShopFloorPc: Full-screen shop-floor PC: production reports, repair requests, inspection rounds, first article
guides.furnaceEnergyPerTonIs: Furnace energy per ton is the main energy metric for melting; industry best practice is ≤ 600 kWh/t.
guides.generatesAccountingVouchersBalancedD: Generates **accounting vouchers** (balanced debits/credits) from shipments, receipts, purchase receipts, payments, material issues, work order costs and more, and exports them for import into **Kingdee Cloud Galaxy / Yonyou U8 / YonSuite**. MES does not keep a general ledger.
guides.getToKnowTheInterface: Get to know the interface in a minute: menu, search, data clock, AI, help
guides.groupedByBusinessAreaProduction: Grouped by business area: Production, Quality, Equipment, Materials, Process… Type keywords in the box at the top (e.g. `oee`, `report`) to jump straight to a page.
guides.honeymomBringsProductionQualityEquip: HoneyMOM brings **production, quality, equipment, materials and traceability** together in one system, with data collected directly from equipment and lines. Take a minute to get to know the interface.
guides.hourlyDailyEndOfShift: Hourly / daily / end of shift / cron; results go to the watch feed, as notifications to certain roles, or into the production daily report. If a tag list or table schema change breaks a query, the skill is marked "Broken" and its owner is notified.
guides.hourlyOeeAndStatusTimeline: Hourly OEE and status timeline: green = running, amber = idle, blue = changeover, red = down. You can see at a glance when downtime clusters.
guides.howManyPiecesMachiningAnd: How many pieces machining and foundry produce each shift, how many hours the molding line runs, and the raw casting stock at shift end.
guides.howNonconformancesWereDispositionedR: How nonconformances were dispositioned (rework, scrap, use as is). When the scrap share is high, go to "Defect Backtrace" to find causes on the foundry side.
guides.iLlRespondMeansSomeone: "I'll Respond" means someone is on it; when done, click "Close" and enter the resolution. Waiting time counts toward response time statistics.
guides.inExternalErpModeErp: In external ERP mode, ERP-mastered data is read-only in the MES UI (synced in only via API / staging DB / connector); MES writes back completions, material issues, receipts, shipments and inventory.
guides.inQualityOverviewCheckThe: In "Quality Overview", check the defect Pareto (fix the biggest categories first) and the disposition breakdown. If the same defect keeps recurring, start an 8D.
guides.inspectionRecordsAndValuesFor: Inspection records and values for first article, patrol and final inspections. For the full workflow see "Walkthrough: Quality Inspection".
guides.inspectionRoundsPmAndLubrication: Inspection rounds, PM and lubrication tasks due today or overdue. Once done they're scheduled for the next cycle automatically; an **abnormal inspection result creates a repair order automatically**.
guides.inspectionVolumeNgRatePending: Inspection volume, NG rate, pending nonconformances and process capability (Cpk) of key dimensions over a period. **Review this page at the daily quality meeting**.
guides.itemsBelowSafetyStockAre: Items below safety stock are red. Right-click a row to see its transactions or raise a material request.
guides.launchAndTrack8dsFor: Launch and track 8Ds for systemic quality issues: D1 team through D8 closure. Can be started directly from Defect Backtrace.
guides.leaveUnitPriceEmptyTo: Leave unit price empty to fill it automatically (sales from the customer price list, purchasing from the supply list). Delivery orders / receipts are usually created from the order with "Create Delivery Order / Receive".
guides.letYourOwnAiTools: Let your own AI tools (Claude Desktop, Cursor, Dify…) query MES and equipment data over **MCP**: read-only by default, each key has its own permissions and data scope, every call is audited and rate-limited per key.
guides.linesForCSiAnd: Lines for C, Si and CE, bars for energy per ton. Heats with CE outside 4.15–4.45 deserve close attention.
guides.loadPerWorkstationGroupWeek: Load per workstation group × week: scheduled hours + planned production hours vs capacity; overloads in red.
guides.materialsBomsRoutingsEmployeesWareho: Materials, BOMs, routings, employees, warehouses… master data and records like these all use the same page: search and filters on top, a table below.
guides.medianP90StandardBaselineFor: Median / P90 / standard / baseline for each motion, a Gantt of recent cycles, time distribution and daily drift. For slow motions you can have AI explain the cause, or draft a repair order in one click (created only after approval).
guides.modeOwnershipQueueFailuresWebhooks: Mode & Ownership → Queue & Failures → Webhooks → Staging DB → Kingdee / Yonyou. External system developers can use the API docs at the top right (/api/docs).
guides.n2d3dToggleImportDxf: 2D / 3D toggle, import DXF, auto-place, drag to place. Equipment color = live status (running / idle / down / offline).
guides.newestAtTheTopHold: Newest at the top. Hold `Ctrl` and click a row to have AI check it for anomalies. For the full workflow see "Walkthrough: Report Production".
guides.noAiNeededValuesThat: No AI needed: values that never change, are out of range, are uncorrelated with running status, or don't match the tag list declaration (declared as a counter but decreasing…).
guides.oeeAvailabilityPerformanceQualityAll: OEE = Availability × Performance × Quality, all **calculated automatically** from equipment status and part events, with no manual entry. Use it to find which machine and which cause is losing capacity.
guides.onHandStockAndSafety: On-hand stock and safety stock for materials in each warehouse. Charge material backflush, raw casting transfers, finished goods receipts and shipments are all **posted automatically**.
guides.onSiteTagListsOften: On-site tag lists often have only PLC addresses and pinyin abbreviations. AI drafts the meaning / unit / equipment / purpose from tag names, addresses and observed values; it can also read PLC programs to suggest tags. **Everything is a draft; it enters the model only after an engineer approves**.
guides.onTimeDeliveryIsCalculated: On-time delivery is calculated from schedule lines due in the last 90 days (shipped after the due date counts as late). Click "Overdue" to go to the order list.
guides.onceAPartIsScanned: Once a part is scanned its operations appear here: choose the **operation**, enter **good qty** and **defect qty**; for defects choose a defect code and the system opens an NCR automatically. If reporting isn't allowed (e.g. first article not released), the reason is shown.
guides.onceConfirmedAsASystemic: Once confirmed as a systemic issue, click "Start 8D"; the analysis is carried into the 8D report.
guides.oneBarPerOperationIts: One bar per operation: its position is the planned time, the fill is completion progress; work orders that can't meet their due date are flagged at the top as expected late.
guides.oneBarPerOperationThe: One bar per operation; the fill shows completion progress.
guides.oneDataSourceEachFor: One data source each for OPC UA, MQTT, Sparkplug B, Modbus, HTTP push and staging database. Green status = connected; MQTT can "discover" all topics over a period of time, OPC UA can "browse".
guides.oneModelDrivesTheEquipment: One model drives the equipment register, data collection, 2D / 3D digital twin and the AI data catalog: **Plant → Workshop → Line → Workstation → Equipment → Tag**.
guides.openAmountSummarizedByCustomer: Open amount summarized by customer and by due week, to see which customer has the most backlog.
guides.openAnNcrAndDisposition: Open an NCR and disposition it with the buttons at the top: **Rework**, **Scrap** or **Use As Is**, with a clear note; close it when done.
guides.openMobileAtTheWorkstation: Open "Mobile" at the workstation (phone browser or station tablet), scan the code on the part (scanner or manual entry) and tap "Search". Below you'll see which operation the part is at, its work order and its heat.
guides.openPurchaseOrderLinesOverdue: Open purchase order lines (overdue in red), receipts in incoming inspection, pending requisitions, and **supplier performance** (on-time delivery + incoming defect ppm).
guides.openTheInspectionAndClick: Open the inspection and click "Enter Values": enter measured values for items with limits, choose pass/fail for the rest; on save the overall result is **decided automatically**.
guides.openTheWorkOrderAnd: Open the work order and, while it's a draft, click "**Release**": the system generates operations from the routing and the work order enters scheduling.
guides.operationScheduleAndCompletionProgre: Operation schedule and completion progress for released work orders, with finite-capacity scheduling. For the full workflow see "Walkthrough: Scheduling".
guides.orderBoardOtdOnTime: order board otd on-time delivery sales

guides.overdueExpectedLateDueSoon: Overdue → expected late → due soon but not ready, each with its reason (stock shortage, work order not released, scheduled completion after due date). Click a row to open the order; with AI on, click "AI Risk Check".

guides.perPieceCycleTimeFor: Per-piece cycle time for each workstation (cycle time ÷ parallel machines); red is the bottleneck. If a takt target is set, it's drawn as a red dashed line. Click a bar to see that machine.
guides.pressCtrlKSearchPages: Press `Ctrl` + `K`: search pages, work order numbers, part codes, equipment codes, or type a sentence for AI. Type "tour" to find all guided tours.
guides.productionReportedWorkOrderProgress: Production reported. Work order progress, OEE quality and WIP location all update accordingly.
guides.protocolAddressAndConnectionStatus: Protocol, address and connection status of each data source. Configure them in "Data Sources & Tag Lists".
guides.publishAVersionWhenA: Publish a version when a commissioning phase wraps up; versions can be compared to show added, removed and changed equipment and tags.
guides.qualityInspectionNonconformanceNcrDi: quality inspection nonconformance ncr disposition task walkthrough qc
guides.quotationsSalesOrdersDeliveriesRetur: Quotations, sales orders, deliveries, returns, purchase orders, receipts, supplier returns and invoices all use the same page: **list + right drawer** (header, lines, status-dependent actions, linked documents).
guides.redDotsAreOutOf: Red dots are out-of-control points (beyond control limits or a run trend). Right-click a red dot to have AI check the equipment, cutting tools and heats for that period.
guides.reportProductionScanMobileTask: report production scan mobile task walkthrough reporting
guides.salesOrderOnTimeDelivery: Sales order **on-time delivery**, open orders and **orders at delivery risk**: checks, schedule line by schedule line, whether inventory and the scheduled completion of make-to-order work orders are enough. Planning and sales review it together every morning.
guides.salesOrderPurchaseOrderDelivery: sales order purchase order delivery receipt invoice
guides.scanOrEnterAPart: Scan or enter a part code or heat number. Right-clicking a row on any page and choosing "Trace" also brings you here.
guides.scanReportProductionVerifyOn: Scan → report production → verify on the desktop
guides.scanToReportMyTasks: Scan to report, my tasks, request repair, lookup
guides.scheduleAdjustmentSuggestionsRaisedW: Schedule adjustment suggestions raised when equipment goes down, rush orders arrive or materials run short: review the impact first, then accept or reject.
guides.schedulingProgressSchedulesByPriorit: "Scheduling & Progress" schedules by priority, due date and the number of machines in each workstation group. After a rush order or a due date change, click "**Reschedule**".
guides.schedulingWorkOrderReleaseDispatch: scheduling work order release dispatch gantt task walkthrough schedule
guides.score60OnTimeDelivery: Score = 60 × on-time delivery + 40 × quality score; can be written back to supplier master data as a reference when choosing suppliers.
guides.scrapAndReworkStatisticsBy: Scrap and rework statistics by machine tool, to find the machines and causes where problems concentrate and feed back to **cutting tools and process engineering**.
guides.searchByCodeOrName: Search by code or name, filter by status; "Export" exports CSV with the current filters; with permission, "New" is on the right.
guides.searchByDocumentNumberBusiness: Search by document number / business partner; filter by status, customer or supplier.
guides.selectTheWorkstationFirstThen: Select the workstation first, then use the big buttons below; production reports check first article and lot holds.
guides.sopsWorkInstructionsMaintenanceKnow: SOPs, work instructions, maintenance know-how. With AI on you can ask directly, and answers cite the documents here.
guides.sourceTracesDemandBackTo: "Source" traces demand back to the order; "Adjust" changes quantity / date / supplier; red suggestions are past their release date and need expediting. With AI on you can use "AI Explain".
guides.stackedByEquipmentTypeFor: Stacked by equipment type: for equipment that uses a lot of power during peak hours, see whether it can move to off-peak.
guides.switchBetweenPendingAllAnd: Switch between Pending, All and other views; click a row to open and disposition it: rework, scrap, use as is, or start an 8D.
guides.switchBetweenTabsTheButtons: Switch between tabs; the buttons in each table are that gate's actions (release, hold / release hold, rework complete / re-inspect).
guides.switchToDownOrWith: Switch to "Down" or "With Alarms" to see only machines that need attention; the numbers above are machine counts per status.
guides.tapReportOperationsThatEquipment: Tap "Report". Operations that equipment reports automatically (CNC machines, test stations) don't need manual reporting; they're marked in "My Tasks".
guides.thatSItFromNow: That's it. From now on, the "?" next to every page title opens that page's tour; press Ctrl+K and type "tour" to find all tours and the three task walkthroughs.
guides.thatSThePathFrom: That's the path from creating a work order to dispatching it. After that, progress updates automatically from production reports and equipment data; just check "Scheduling & Progress".
guides.theBiggestPowerConsumersAre: The biggest power consumers are at the top.
guides.theBottleneckStageIsShown: The bottleneck stage is shown in red.
guides.theFirstPageAfterLogin: The first page after login: today's output, OEE, quality, equipment status and **things that need your attention** (alarms, Andon, PM due, approvals) are all here.
guides.theFullEquipmentRepairProcess: The full equipment repair process: request, dispatch, repair, verification. Repair requests come from Live Monitor, mobile, abnormal inspection rounds and Andon.
guides.theFullWorkOrderLifecycle: The full work order lifecycle from draft and release through production to completion. For the full workflow see "Walkthrough: Scheduling".
guides.theMachiningBottleneckSetsThe: The machining bottleneck sets the pace; the foundry schedules by the raw casting stock gap: **never starving machining, never piling up castings**.
guides.theProgressBarIsThe: The progress bar is the life count; click a row to see its cutting load curve. After changing a tool, click Change in the "Cutting Tools" record to reset the count.
guides.theQualityLoopInspectionDecision: The quality loop: inspection → decision → nonconformance → disposition → statistics. Recurring issues are tackled as projects in "8D Reports".
guides.theRedNumberIsActive: The red number is active equipment alarms; click for the alarm log. The bell holds your notifications (Andon, approvals, PM due).
guides.theWorkOrderSCompleted: The work order's completed quantity accumulates with each report. If a quantity was wrong, open that entry in "Production Reports" to edit it.
guides.threeQualityGatesFirstArticle: Three quality gates: first article release, lot hold and rework re-inspection. Batch production can't be reported until the first article is released, held lots can't move, and an NCR can close only after the reworked part passes re-inspection.
guides.tickAndReleaseProductionDraft: Tick and release: production → draft work orders (or release straight to scheduling); purchasing → requisitions or direct purchase orders (merged by supplier); expedite → change the arrival date of open orders.
guides.timeIsBasedOnData: Time is based on data collected from the shop floor. "Collection" next to it shows data source status; red means collection is down. Click it to view system status.
guides.toActOnSomethingSpecific: To act on something specific: equipment issues go to "Equipment › Live Monitor", quality issues to "Quality Overview", progress to "Scheduling & Progress".
guides.toolLifeCountingAndWear: Tool life counting and wear estimation: warning at 90% of life, change the tool when the count is reached. With AI on, **flank wear is also estimated** from spindle load.
guides.toolsAvailableToExternalAi: Tools available to external AI: record search, work orders / output / quality / OEE, plant model and tags, time series, cycle time analysis, traceability, skills. You can try one directly on the right.
guides.uploadTheIntegratorSZip: Upload the integrator's zip, or fetch it from a URL. You'll see a **preview** first: new / changed equipment and tags, which endpoint each protocol connects to, and an issue list; nothing is written to the plant model until you confirm.
guides.useAPhoneOrTablet: Use a phone or tablet on the shop floor: **scan to report**, view **My Tasks**, **request repair**, look up work orders and parts. For the full workflow see "Walkthrough: Report Production".
guides.useWhenTheTagList: Use when the tag list is incomplete: **OPC UA browse** the server's nodes and attributes (display name, description, data type, engineering unit), **MQTT / Sparkplug B discover** all topics and sample values received over a period.
guides.usesLinearProgrammingToFind: Uses linear programming to find the **lowest-cost** charge mix: meeting the chemistry window, per-material ratio limits and stock.
guides.welcomeNewUserGettingStarted: welcome new user getting started onboarding intro
guides.whenChargeCostIsHigh: When charge cost is high or chemistry unstable, go to "Charge Optimization" to recalculate the mix.
guides.whenEquipmentGoesDownOr: When equipment goes down or a rush order comes in, the system suggests schedule adjustments: review the impact, then accept or reject.
guides.whenEquipmentQualityMaterialOr: When equipment, quality, material or safety issues come up on the floor, **pull the Andon**; the right people respond, handle and close it. The board refreshes every 5 seconds.
guides.whenYouGetAGood: When you get a good answer in the right AI panel, click "**Save as Skill**": the question, the queries actually used, the output format and parameters are saved together so you can rerun with new parameters or on a schedule. **Scheduled runs don't call the LLM**; it's called once only if "AI Conclusion" is turned on.
guides.whereARealPlantS: Where a real plant's data gets connected. The system integrator delivers a **tag list + floor plan + 3D models** (the delivery package) per the Connectivity Spec; here you import, validate, check point by point and confirm it, then generate and sign the commissioning acceptance report.
guides.whetherDataCollectionIsWorking: Whether data collection is working and whether an LLM is configured. Check here first when collection drops or the data clock stops.
guides.withTheMasterSwitchOff: With the master switch off, no AI features are available; non-AI features work as usual.
guides.workOrderActualCostMaterial: Work order **actual cost** (material at moving average, labor / machine at reported hours × rate, energy at equipment hourly power, overhead by allocation rules) vs **standard cost**; inventory valuation; **month-end close** locks the period.
guides.workOrderCostsVarianceAnalysis: Work order costs, variance analysis (by product / period / work order), inventory valuation, month-end close.
guides.xRControlChartsProcess: X̄-R control charts, process capability (Cp, Cpk, Ppk) and out-of-control rules for key dimensions. Use them to judge whether a process is **stable and capable of meeting tolerance**.
guides.youCanEditEquipmentMeaning: You can edit equipment, meaning, unit and purpose directly in the table; edited tags are "Approved with Edits".
guides.yourOwnSkillsAndSkills: Your own skills and skills shared with your role. 6 built in: end-of-shift output summary, bottleneck motion daily report, top 5 OEE losses, daily quality Pareto, overdue PM, energy anomalies.

guidesexec.affectedDataIsListedAutomatically: Affected data is listed automatically and implementation tasks are generated; revise documents under the ECN, and they take effect with the ECN once approved.
guidesexec.changeRequestAutomaticImpactAnalysis: Change request → **automatic impact analysis** (routings, BOMs, open work orders, WIP, inventory, controlled documents, inspection templates) → approval (e-signature) → implementation tasks → effective, with both old and new versions recorded.
guidesexec.chooseAPrinterOrMarker: Choose a printer or marker. Jobs that can't connect retry automatically; see each attempt in "Print Jobs". Reprints require a reason and are audited.
guidesexec.chooseAProductAndOperation: Choose a product and operation to see the documents displayed on the floor right now; obsolete versions disappear automatically.
guidesexec.clickARowToLog: Click a row to log calibration, upload certificates, release (e-signature) and print gauge status labels.
guidesexec.clickARowToSee: Click a row to see the impact analysis; hold affected in-plant lots, notify stakeholders, start an 8D or create a return in one click.
guidesexec.createAStudyByChoosing: Create a study by choosing the method and gauge; enter data directly or paste CSV.
guidesexec.createFromDeliveryOrderFills: "Create from Delivery Order" fills in customer, delivery address and quantities; with external ERP, create manually and enter the delivery order number.
guidesexec.createLoadingListsFromDelivery: Create loading lists from delivery orders, scan pallets to load; after **shipment confirmation** parts are marked shipped and issued from stock, and an ASN is generated (JSON, Excel, flat file, EDIFACT sample).
guidesexec.currentAndPendingVersionsClick: Current and pending versions; click a row to see version history, signatures and content.
guidesexec.dragElementsToPositionThem: Drag elements to position them, drag corner handles to resize; arrow keys nudge 0.5 mm. Variables like `{{sn}}` are filled from the business object at print time.
guidesexec.eSignaturesForFirstArticle: **E-signatures** for first article release, lot hold release, ECN approval, gauge release, 8D closure, document approval and complaint closure: who, when, meaning, object and summary, also written to the audit log.
guidesexec.enterAHeatPartCode: Enter a heat, part code, carton ID or loading list to get the recall scope and report in seconds, without holding anything.
guidesexec.filterByPurposeDuplicateA: Filter by purpose; "Duplicate" a built-in template before editing, and when a customer has its own label spec, adjust field positions and data identifiers to match.
guidesexec.gaugeRegisterCalibrationScheduleAnd: Gauge register, calibration schedule and certificates. **Reminders before due, automatic lock when overdue**; after calibration, release by e-signature before use. Inspection entry can only select valid gauges.
guidesexec.grRAverageRangeAnova: GR&R (average & range, ANOVA: %GRR, ndc), bias, linearity, attribute agreement (kappa). Algorithms verified against the AIAG MSA 4th edition examples.
guidesexec.grr10Acceptable1030: %GRR < 10% acceptable, 10–30% conditionally acceptable, > 30% unacceptable; ndc ≥ 5. Results are written back to the gauge register.
guidesexec.itemsWithCharacteristicsBecomeContro: Items with characteristics become control plan rows (specification, evaluation method, gauge type, sample frequency, reaction plan), then generate inspection templates in one click.
guidesexec.labelBarcodePrintZplTspl: label barcode print zpl tspl marking
guidesexec.labelTemplatesForPartsLots: **Label templates** for parts, lots, cartons, pallets, customer labels (automotive shipping label layouts), locations, gauges and tooling: designed in millimetres, printed to Zebra ZPL / TSC TSPL network printers (TCP 9100), the browser (exact-size PDF) or laser markers.
guidesexec.logACustomerComplaintDelivery: Log a customer complaint (delivery order, part code, lot, carton ID) → **trace the impact scope** (shipped / in plant, which customers) → hold what's in the plant → 8D → close with e-signature. Recall simulations are for regular traceability drills.
guidesexec.newEcnDescribeTheChange: "New ECN": describe the change, choose the product and how WIP work orders are handled (continue as is / stop / finish then switch).
guidesexec.operationsDoneBySuppliersSuch: Operations done by suppliers, such as heat treatment and coating: **ship out** (stock moves to the outsourcing warehouse) → **receive & inspect** (good back to stock, scrap logged as nonconformance, losses charged back) → **settle** into AP.
guidesexec.operationsMarkedOutsourcedInThe: Operations marked "Outsourced" in the routing automatically create a draft outsourcing order when the work order is released, and scheduling uses the supplier's lead time.
guidesexec.processFmeaSOD: Process FMEA (S / O / D, RPN, AIAG-VDA action priority AP) → **generate control plan** → **generate inspection templates**; special characteristics CC / SC carry through to SPC and labels. Control plan changes go through an ECN and sync to inspection entry once effective.
guidesexec.quantitiesOutAndOverdueOrders: Quantities out and overdue orders at a glance; the supplier table shows pass rate and processing fees.
guidesexec.redMeansBelowMinimumStock: Red means below minimum stock; replenish critical spares first.
guidesexec.rpnAndApRecalculateAutomatically: RPN and AP recalculate automatically when S / O / D change; high AP items need actions. With the AI quality assistant on, it can draft items from historical defects (as drafts first).
guidesexec.scanDirectlyWithTheScanner: Scan directly with the scanner; carton IDs go onto the pallet. If you scanned the wrong one, "Remove" it from the current carton.
guidesexec.scanPartCodesToPack: Scan part codes to pack; full cartons are sealed and labeled automatically. Scan carton IDs to palletize; full pallets get pallet and customer labels. **Held lots, duplicate packing and mixed lots are blocked**.
guidesexec.scheduleGaugesDueSoonWithin: Schedule gauges due soon (within 30 days) for calibration; expired/locked gauges are blocked in inspection entry with the reason shown.
guidesexec.sealsAutomaticallyWhenProgressReache: Seals automatically when progress reaches capacity (packing rule: customer + product → qty per carton, cartons per pallet); can also be sealed manually when not full.
guidesexec.sparePartsRegisterAndStock: Spare parts register and stock (min / max), issued to repair orders / PM records, usage history by equipment; below minimum stock a **replenishment suggestion** is generated and pushed to purchasing.
guidesexec.suggestedQtyTopUpTo: Suggested qty = top up to max stock; tick and push to purchasing (built-in ERP creates requisitions).
guidesexec.theAsnGoesToThe: The ASN goes to the customer as pallet → carton → part code; traceability can look up every piece from the ASN.
guidesexec.versionControlForWorkInstructions: **Version control** for work instructions, drawings, NC programs and control plans: draft → review → approval (e-signature) → effective → obsolete. **Workstation Terminal, mobile and Knowledge Base show only the effective version**.

guidesimpl.industryTemplatesInjectionMoldingAss: industry templates injection molding assembly foundry machining

guidesimpl.newWorkflowChooseWhichAction: "New Workflow": choose which action on which entity it attaches to, when approval is required, how many steps and who approves each. You can "Test Run" it first.
guidesimpl.overallProgressAndOverdueItems: Overall progress and overdue items; below, completion for each phase (survey, blueprint, master data, configuration, connectivity, training, go-live, trial run, acceptance).
guidesimpl.saveShareSchedulePinTo: Save / Share / Schedule / Pin to Home
guidesimpl.theInitializationWorkbookContainsEve: The "Initialization Workbook" contains every template in one file: fill in the whole workbook and upload it, and the system splits it by sheet name into separate import jobs for you to review and confirm one by one.
guidesimpl.theTaskListOfAn: The **task list** of an implementation project from survey to acceptance: each item has an owner, due date, deliverable template (implementation templates folder under docs/) and system entry point; progress tracked by phase.
guidesimpl.tickTheIndustriesMultipleAllowed: Tick the industries (multiple allowed), "Preview" to see which operations, defect codes, inspection templates and reports will be created, then "Apply". Don't tick "Include Demo Data" for production go-live.
guidesimpl.whenSavingYouCanShare: When saving you can share by role and schedule daily / weekly / monthly Excel or PDF exports to in-app notifications; after "Pin to Home" it can be dragged and hidden on Home like any other widget.
guidesimpl.youCanComeBackAnd: You can come back and change any step; when done, click "Finish & Enter System".
